app.title: Turn a WiFi 7 Router into a 320Msps Software Defined Radio Receiver

app.description: Firmware and software to transform a WiFi 7 router into a high-speed SDR receiver.
proposed_tests: Clone repo, compile firmware, flash to router.
Run receiver script and capture a known signal.
Compare against a commercial SDR device.
